DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS) secondary to haloperidol use.

The patient is a 22-year-old male with fever, altered mentation, and a history of tics treated with haloperidol, presenting with rigors but no other focal neurological deficits or infectious symptoms. Given the medication history and clinical presentation, this is highly suggestive of NMS.
